text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Morocco on Tuesday and was expected to have talks with King Hassan on the latest developments in the Middle East peace process.
Arafat flew in from Brussels where he had signed a trade deal with the European Union and called on the 15-nation bloc to strengthen political relations.
Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali welcomed the Palestinian leader, who inspected an honour guard before leaving the airport for the capital.
Neither he nor Filali made any statement, but one official said earlier: "Arafat is expected to meet King Hassan for talks on the Middle East."
